description: Companion to chat-passages-load.json, for non-empty selection: 500 valid approved claims in one site alternating between 2 spans (selectable within the 8-passage limit) and 20 spans (the ClaimInput.Validate maximum), 5,500 spans in all, plus a foreign tenant's spans cited by one more claim. Run by the bound manifest as its selection_companion. The same before/after comparison of selections and of each question's ranking rows, the same thresholds frozen in chat-passages-load.json (never edit them to make a run pass), and a run that selects no passage at all fails (the comparison would be vacuous).
